lifecycle_preparation.role_policy: three real worker/controller/coordinator samples; ordinary per-role limits unchanged; SSH20 CPU seconds/32MiB stay unused and are never reallocated
lifecycle_preparation.local_execution_root: fixed private native WSL root in reviewed caller; every journal/lock/marker/cache/output/diagnostic path under this root; local/remote source worktree metadata must identify the same local worktree
lifecycle_preparation.qualification: real local-process mode may qualify through complete invented lifecycle; existing invented-only local_pipe_test and fake SSH samples remain disallowed for qualification
lifecycle_preparation.failure_policy: existing durable STARTED/terminal/ACK/locks/unresolved marker and zero automatic actual retries remain; no new journal/transport/storage protocol

typed_projection.input: existing intraday_ed_inputs.SessionInputs containing caller-authenticated Minute mapping; opaque source provenance retained without certification
typed_projection.universe: caller must retain original monthly targets and unknown coordinates; this session adapter cannot select/drop targets
typed_projection.bar_clock: opening-aligned blocks; require five exact minute starts, observed price, exact positive Decimal OHLC, valid identity and availability
typed_projection.available_at: block end+2 minutes, only if every minute completion<=available_at<=that block deadline; data later than deadline is unavailable, not used
typed_projection.missing_or_nonobserved: truncate causal bar prefix at first requested missing/nonobserved/not-yet-available minute; do not manufacture flat bars; preserve issue reason
typed_projection.invalid: malformed identity, numeric payload, impossible clock or observed/nonobserved payload conflict => explicit integrity refusal for affected policy
typed_projection.lazy: do not consume/validate source suffix not needed for a completed signal or its path; cache only demanded five-minute projections across arms
typed_projection.unused_volume: none of current primary predicates consumes shares/quote-volume; missing volume cannot be turned into a price gap
typed_projection.previous_terminal: explicit per-scenario mapping, never share actual exit/previous evidence between selected/control arms without caller adjudication
typed_projection.candidate_to_path: eligible True/False/None maps pass/decline/unknown exactly; path admission unknown or declined must not read future prices
typed_projection.errors: path refusal separate from ordinary outcome unknown; no numeric result for either; no swallowed source error -> return0
typed_projection.provenance: include original opaque source metadata or identity in the returned session record, separate from scientific admission; no path/file IO

independent_verification.kind: source-neutral independent scientific reference over original supplied one-minute rows; NOT a second invocation of production detector/path
allowed_trusted_boundaries: existing Minute and ProfitFact immutable input types
shared generic lossless scalar codec if used only for serialization
reconstruct: A15-minute context and C comparable-profit admission/common support
delayed OPEN gates/stop/target/response/time-cap path and exact fixed-cost labels
unknown vs no-candidate vs declined vs invalid
independent_verification.mutations: reject changed timing, levels, information support, return values, missing statuses or reentry identity, using invented positive and negative cases
independent_verification.claim_limit: typed-session mathematical comparison only; actual archive authentication, full-population checks, accounts, lifecycle publication and full actual receipts still separate

source_reuse.existing: intraday_ed_sources audited raw-source decoder and byte index, existing WSL unit/budget/journal/storage

original_population_preparation.scope: source-only first-attempt A/B and their registered controls over a caller-authenticated UniverseCalendar and unchanged-byte reader; no path/file IO or authenticity claim
original_population_preparation.before_raw_read: validate complete original calendar and both timing clocks, target identity/rank/count-state/opaque metadata, duplicate coordinates and per-day ranks; expected full original geometry and authentic pins remain caller obligations
original_population_preparation.iteration: sorted union(session,symbol), retain every original TargetCoordinate including unknown stored counts, load each CC/CX once per union coordinate; do not reuse old EA/ED signal masks
original_population_preparation.verification: decode production and independent reference sessions separately from the same original raw chunks, then independently reconstruct and compare all four policy results; propagate reader changes or mismatches
original_population_preparation.bounded: retain one current raw/decoded session only; reader unchanged checks and fixed checkpoints before/after each session
not_completed_by_this_helper: market performance or executable fill certification
